---

### Adversarial Testing & Review Findings

#### 1. A5.1 Receptionist-Only Check-In & Status Primitives
- The plan explicitly specifies dedicated routes `POST /api/v1/appointments/proposals/check-in/{appointment_id}` and `POST /api/v1/appointments/proposals/check-in/confirm` using operation ID `confirmAppointmentCheckInProposal`.
- The transition is strictly bounded to `Booked|Confirmed -> Arrived`.
- Confirmer role is restricted strictly to `UserRole.Receptionist`. Other roles (`Admin`, `PracticeOwner`, `GP`, `Nurse`) are excluded from A5.1.
- Default-off admission gated per explicit authored-synthetic practice ID.

#### 2. Waiting-Area Semantics & Revalidation
- Waiting area assignment semantics in section 4.2 of the plan are clearly specified:
  - An explicit non-null `waiting_area_id` UUID assigns only when no area is currently set.
  - An omitted or `null` value preserves existing area without removing or moving it.
  - Removal or relocation of an already assigned waiting area is prohibited in A5.1.
  - Every preserved or newly assigned waiting area is revalidated as active, belonging to the same practice, and location-compatible (same non-null `location_id`).

#### 3. Expiring Signed Nonce, Replay & Storage Semantics
- Evidence uses an opaque, server-minted HMAC-signed token with random nonce, purpose, issued-at, and expiry.
- Storage uses a unique partial index on `(practice_id, operation_id, confirmation_evidence_hash)` in `appointment_command_idempotency`.
- Conflict-aware insert (savepoint / `on_conflict_do_nothing`) is required to classify concurrent duplicate attempts cleanly.
- Same-key exact replay is resolved first via stored receipt; any different-key reuse of the consumed hash returns `confirmation_replay_rejected` (even after appointment state restoration).

#### 4. Audit, Committed Events, Schema & Outbox Filtering
- Atomic transaction guarantees: state update to `Arrived`, waiting area assignment, audit log append (`AppointmentAuditLog`), committed event append (`DiaryCommittedEvent` for `diary.appointment_checked_in.v1`), and idempotency receipt completion.
- Plan mandates replacing three existing Postgres `CheckConstraint`s on `diary_committed_events` (`ck_diary_committed_events_type`, `ck_diary_committed_events_schema`, `ck_diary_committed_events_payload_allowlist`) to accommodate both `diary.appointment_rescheduled` and `diary.appointment_checked_in`.
- Reschedule feeds and cursor queries explicitly filter on `event_type = 'diary.appointment_rescheduled'`, isolating checked-in events completely.

#### 5. B4.1 Default-Location Command Family & Attestation
- B4.1 mounts a 3-step proposal/attestation/confirm family:
  1. Proposal generation (120s max TTL, zero DB write).
  2. Human attestation route `POST /practice-administration/practitioners/default-location/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirmation-evidence` returning an opaque server-held single-use reference.
  3. Confirmation route consuming evidence and executing aggregate update.
- Gated default-off behind feature flag and synthetic practice allowlist checked before resource lookup.

#### 6. Server Mapping & Role Normalization
- Explicit mapping defined in section 5.3:
  - `UserRole.Admin -> practice_manager`
  - `UserRole.PracticeOwner -> practice_owner`
- Mapping occurs server-side before checking body assertion equality. No client aliases or client-selected role mappings permitted.

#### 7. Bounded Headers, Correlation & Secret Management
- Headers `Idempotency-Key` and `X-Correlation-Id` mandatory across all three B4.1 routes.
- Strict correlation equality required between header `X-Correlation-Id`, body session-binding `correlation_id`, and signed proposal `correlation_id`.
- Dedicated server-side B4 command secret used for signing. Fails closed if unconfigured. No persistence of raw idempotency keys or bearer tokens.

#### 8. B4 Transaction Ordering, Aggregate Version & Outbox
- Confirm route locks practitioner aggregate and confirmation evidence row, validates aggregate version and before-state hash, updates `default_location_id`, increments `aggregate_version` once, marks evidence consumed, appends audit, and appends outbox event (`practice.practitioner_default_location_changed.v1`).
- Outbox is append-only, patient-free, and unpublished (storage only). RLS enforced.

#### 9. Declarative OpenAPI Specs & Migration Alignment
- OpenAPI specification `docs/api-spine/openapi/practice-administration-default-location-commands.yaml` updated to incorporate the explicit attestation route, schemas, role mappings, and zero-domain-mutation guarantees.
- Single sequential Alembic migration chain maintained following `u0v1w2x3y4z5`.
- Acceptance matrix strictly uses authored-synthetic fixtures and requires zero product-provider calls.

---

### Conclusion

Plan revision 3 is thorough, unambiguous, internally consistent, and enforces strict architecture and security controls without expanding authority boundaries.

DECISION: pass
